Required-test coverage for accepted positive and absent object characteristics
Required-test coverage for successful import contents and atomic rollback on failure
Required-test coverage and concurrency requirements for request-ID uniqueness
Facts and owner-session identity stored and compared for request-ID replay
dispositions.reason: A01 rule 6 compares the facts each create names: for a publish, the project and the publisher principal (M07). The owner is one principal whatever its session; Kernel names the session. Which fields form current_facts per model is the contract's (State 6); no owner-session identity is a fact of a record (M11 is never recorded).

dispositions.topic_text: Serialization and winner of an import-confirmation conflict with an ordinary create
dispositions.reason: No operation but the import takes an id from its caller: every other create mints its id (Identity formats), so no ordinary create can choose an imported id; the import's conflict check runs in its one write transaction (A16 rules 6, 7).
